name: XPS Pensions Group plc
summary: XPS Pensions Group plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides consulting and administration services related to UK pension schemes and insurers in the United Kingdom. It offers convent and pension advisory; investment and insurance consulting; DB master trust schemes; and self-invested personal pension and SSAS pension services. The company also provides pension administration services, such as scheme administration, outsourcing, payroll, scheme accounting, communications, and scam identification and protection, as well as de-risking projects, GMP equalization, data audits and cleansing, and trustee secretarial services.
